limitations: Six requested still-frame samples, not an every-frame, motion or audio-listening review.
Safe-area judgment is for uncropped 1920x1080 landscape; platform UI overlays and portrait crops were not tested.
Night skyline is dark in both closing frames, while CTA remains clear.
No city-scale 1:1 fidelity, real-time FPS or audience-performance approval is implied.
